summary: I adopt the preceding Astra assessment after reading the exact candidate and report and checking its main Riccati/transversality argument. The arbitrary positive-parameter one-fold criterion and scalar radial consequences are supported. The original minor_revision and score 4 are retained. AUTHOR-CLARIFICATION.md and the separate clarification review adequately address the close Watson-ratio reference, mean-domain typo, optional tangency and lambda=0 conventions when visibly associated with this unchanged PDF. No material disagreement was found; rate-distortion imports and incomplete priority/numerical coverage remain limited. This is a current-context intake adoption after reading a preceding Astra report, not fresh blind independent review or output of the original agent.
strengths: Two-variable Riccati/transversality proof covers every a>0,c>a without assuming a=1.
Integration-by-parts upper bound handles a=1 correctly and expressly does not extend it to a<1.
The scalar envelope, active-radius derivative and Bessel/Beta scaling are internally consistent.
The manuscript distinguishes oriented-two-plane numerical observations from proofs and states the missing fixed-norm extremum for real/quaternionic rate-distortion.
weaknesses: Related-work discussion omits Sra and Karp (2013), whose general Kummer-ratio monotonicity and inverse bounds are especially close background. A 2024 integrable-bounds paper was located but full text access failed, so that comparison remains incomplete.

The hypothetical tangency at m_f=1/2 can actually be excluded: D=0,D'=0 there imply D''=16(c+1)(1-2mu)>0, incompatible with D<0 immediately to the left. This sharpens, rather than invalidates, Theorem 4.1.
Numerical coverage is bounded; no finite grid certifies all parameters or zero counts.

The minor findings are addressed in separate same-hash AUTHOR-CLARIFICATION.md and final-astra/CLARIFICATION-REVIEW.json, provided they visibly accompany the unchanged PDF. The original minor_revision recommendation remains preserved; this is not an editorial disposition.
potential_errors: Nonmaterial domain typo in Theorem 4.1 proof: [m_f,infinity) should be [m_f,1).
Subdifferential formulas at the boundary lambda=0 should be read for positive lambda or with the appropriate one-sided convention.
strong_novelty_candidates: The global zero count of H=K'-kappa K'' for arbitrary a>0,c>a with threshold c=2a.
The resulting unified scalar phase diagram together with explicit fold bounds for a>=1.
